description.from:
## Scope

Ship a small offline walkthrough and explicit live interfaces; add a DSPy bridge only when it runs real automated optimization through the decision-model contract.

## Definition of done

Documented local workflow, reproducible fixtures, release-ready package, and evidence links; optional integrations have demonstrated optimization value.
description.to:
## Scope

Ship a small offline walkthrough and explicit live interfaces around the native, provider-neutral Decision Flywheel optimizer. Do not add DSPy or another orchestration framework.

## Definition of done

Documented local workflow, reproducible fixtures, release-ready package, and evidence links for native optimization; no optional DSPy integration is in scope.
